title: Spacetime Reverser
text: Ordinary Temporal Silt becomes Living Temporal Silt in five seconds for one energy, without changing quantity. Sedimented and rotted silt still rewind one stage and become activated.

The Spacetime Reverser takes five seconds and one energy per operation, storing up to 64. Spatial Crystals supply 1; Timeflow Eels and Chronal Blindfish 2; Warp Points, reborn lilies and either consumable memory 4; Time and Space Microcores 8. Two Warp Points yield one Time Microcore, while sixteen Spatial Crystals yield one Space Microcore.
Exchange memory cubes and lilies, rewind and activate silt, condense microcores, or uncover the past of unknown fossils and eggs. See recipes for quantities.

Condense remains into royal essences, or inactive T-virus solution into psychic talent solution. Each grants a talent together with Time Distortion. An existing talent prevents consumption; the Cleansing Ritual removes both talent and curse.
